name: pr-feedback
description: Consume-side PR review workflow. resolve-pr-feedback: fetch every unresolved review thread and comment on a GitHub PR in one paginated pass, judge each item centrally against the actual code (fixed / fixed-differently / declined / not-addressing / replied / needs-human), apply valid fixes to the working tree, and draft quoted replies — posting and resolving only after explicit user approval. Never commits, pushes, merges, or approves.
